description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty Internal Plugin for compiling the {extends} tag, including class definition, methods for compiling templates, and handling inheritance logic.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Extends
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling the {extends} tag in Smarty templates, handling inheritance and template inclusion.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles code for the {extends} tag, managing inheritance logic and template inclusion.

methods.name: compileEndChild
methods.description: Adds code to mark the end of inheritance for a template, optionally including a parent template.

methods.name: compileInclude
methods.description: Adds code to include a subtemplate at the end of the current template.

methods.name: extendsSourceArrayCode
methods.description: Creates source code for {extends} based on source components array.
